alex_support: Escalation from Acme — customer reports records still visible after retention TTL expired for dataset ds-9a4b. They say delete TTL was 2026-02-20T03:12:00Z but API GET still returns 200 and objects present. They need proof of deletion + audit logs ASAP. Customer is asking for compliance attestation within 24h. Adding logs they attached.
jamal_sre: Can you paste the exact API call they used and the tenant id? Also need the timeframe + any error IDs. I can check delete-worker queues and audit stream.
alex_support: API call they used: `DELETE /v1/datasets/ds-9a4b` via our dashboard (tenant acme). Timestamp they provided: 2026-02-20T03:12:01Z. They also tried `GET /v1/datasets/ds-9a4b` 2026-02-22 and got 200 with data blob. Attached screenshot.
devon_eng: Looking at metrics around 2026-02-20 — there was a brief spike on delete-worker latency and a backlog on the purge queue (worker restarts). Query to check: ```sql
SELECT * FROM delete_jobs WHERE tenant='acme' AND dataset_id='ds-9a4b' ORDER BY enqueued_at DESC LIMIT 20;
```
jamal_sre: Ran that query — found job entries. Notable: `retention_override=+30d` for tenant acme (this would push scheduled purge out). Also found a failure: `job_id=jb-88a failing: KMS_DECRYPT_ERROR` at 2026-02-25T03:14:05Z.
maria_security: KMS note — if the key used to encrypt the dataset enters pending deletion or rotation, we can see decrypt failures which block purges that validate integrity before physical deletion. Need the KMS key id. Also: physical purge has a short grace window for backups; backups may retain encrypted shards until their own TTL.
ops_bot: incident-bot: Created incident INC-20260225-17 (retention:acme) and paged oncall. :rotating_light:
jamal_sre: Pulled audit stream for ds-9a4b: 
```
2026-02-20T03:12:01Z audit: DELETE dataset ds-9a4b requested by user:acme-admin retention=default
2026-02-20T03:12:02Z audit: delete-job enqueued job_id=jb-88a tenant=acme
2026-02-25T03:14:05Z audit: delete-job failed job_id=jb-88a error=KMS_DECRYPT_ERROR key=p-abc
2026-02-25T03:14:10Z audit: delete-job retried job_id=jb-88a status=queued
```
jamal_sre: Root cause looks like a combination: tenant had a custom retention_override (+30d) plus a KMS decrypt error that prevented successful purge of encrypted shards. The API GET returned cached objects from S3-cache while purge was pending.
devon_eng: I can trigger an emergency sweep for the dataset once security approves. CLI command for ops: ```bash
redwood-admin purge --tenant acme --dataset ds-9a4b --force --reason "compliance-attestation"
```
maria_security: Do NOT force-purge without privacy/legal sign-off. If KMS key is in pending deletion we need to coordinate with keys team; forcing purge will remove forensic evidence we might need for attestation. Recommend: (1) confirm KMS key state (key id p-abc), (2) attempt key re-enable / restore if available, (3) run selective purge of expired metadata after we verify backups.
alex_support: Customer is P0 and asking for timeline. Can we provide an ETA to get them attestation and the audit log lines?
jamal_sre: ETA: I can produce the audit log extract and list of queued jobs within 2 hours. If keys team can confirm key p-abc is re-enabled within 6 hours, we can complete purge and provide attestation within 12 hours. If key is permanently deleted, we'll need legal + backups team input — that could extend timeline.
maria_security: I will loop in keys-team and privacy. Assigning: `@maria_security` to coordinate keys/privacy, `@jamal_sre` to extract logs and status, `@devon_eng` to prep purge playbook but hold execution.
alex_support: Thanks — I'll update the customer: provide audit snippets (from jamal) and tell them we're coordinating and aim for attestation in 12h pending key recovery. Please post updates here as soon as you have them. :white_check_mark:
